answer: Each identity must hold a certified food handler certificate, earned in an in-person hygiene course with an exam costing about $35 per candidate. A farm needs a distinct trained person per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost $35,000 plus a full day of training each. The walnut shell of cheap aliases cracks: every fake adds another course, the ferrous gate of the hygiene exam cannot be passed in bulk, and the cedar register of certificates exposes duplicates.
